create_class_M: create a PyTorch neural network class M with three linear layers and ReLU activations
run_training_loop: run a training loop that performs forward pass, loss computation, and gradient descent for 10000 iterations
optimize_model_params: optimize model parameters using manual gradient descent with a learning rate of 1e-3
zero_gradients: zero gradients of all model parameters before each training step
measure_training_speed: measure training speed in iterations per second and print final loss after training
